# FixedStepClock

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/physics/`](../folders/src-physics.md)
> **Source:** [`src/physics/physics_sys.h`](../../../src/physics/physics_sys.h), [`src/physics/physics_sys.cpp`](../../../src/physics/physics_sys.cpp)

## Summary

Host fixed-step accumulator shared by TerrainCollidersSys (looks ahead at this frame's steps) and PhysicsSys (takes them).

## Description

Created on demand (find-or-emplace) by PhysicsSys::preinit or the first TerrainCollidersSys tick. fixed_dt = 1/60 s, at most max_steps = 4 steps per frame. stepsFor(dt) = min(floor((accumulator + min(dt, 0.25)) / fixed_dt), 4) and is const, so TerrainCollidersSys and PhysicsSys compute the same step count in one frame as long as TerrainColliders runs first. PhysicsSys adds min(dt, 0.25) to accumulator, subtracts steps * fixed_dt after stepping and resets accumulator to 0 when it still exceeds fixed_dt (slow frames drop simulation time). sim_time advances by fixed_dt per step and is the time base of the host's TerrainColliders eviction. World registries do not use it (they use WorldClock).

| `accumulator` | `double` | 0. | Unsimulated frame time, seconds; accumulator / fixed_dt is the interpolation alpha. |
| `sim_time` | `double` | 0. | Simulated time, seconds (steps * fixed_dt). |
